title: Modules
text: Turn features on or off for each unit. Units below follow unless they choose otherwise or you lock it.
read_only: You can see module settings. Changing them needs the "Turn modules on and off" permission.
empty_text: Try another filter or search word.

confirm.on_text: It becomes available in {org} and the units below it.
confirm.off_text: People in {org} and below lose access to it. No data is deleted.
confirm.lock_hint: Units below cannot change this themselves.
confirm.dependents_text: Turning off {name} also turns off these modules:
confirm.inherit_text: This unit's own choice is removed and the parent's setting applies.

consent.title: Consent for {name}
consent.text: This module sends data to an AI service. An administrator must agree to the data-processing terms first.
consent.agree: I agree to the data-processing terms (version {version}) for this organization.
consent.must_agree: Tick the box to confirm you agree to the terms.
consent.withdraw_text: The module turns off right away for this organization.

purge.title: Delete all {name} data?
purge.text: Every record of this module in {org} will be deleted after a waiting period. Until then you can cancel.

app.title: Screens for this module are on the way
app.text: The {module} module is on for your organization. Its pages arrive in its own release.
